about: Conformance vectors of the access decision (src/decide.mjs; the Rust port in rust/ runs the same file). Expectations are written by hand from the rules in DESIGN.md, not computed by the code under test. list: fixture = fixtures/geoblock.fixture.json, real = ../geoblock.json, null = no list. sanctions: fresh = fixtures/sanctions-fixture.json, null = none.
